# dseams-rs

> dseams-rs holds the Rust crates for d-SEAMS: `dseams-sys`, raw declarations for the libseams C API, and `dseams`, safe handles for CHILL and CHILL+ ice labels, Steinhardt order parameters, primitive rings, cages, RDFs, hydrogen bonds and topological fingerprints of molecular simulation frames.

The crates.io packages are `dseams-sys` and `dseams`; the library names are `seams_sys` and `seams`, so code says `use seams::System`. Rust 1.85 or newer builds them. `dseams-sys` links the shared libseams in `SEAMS_LIBDIR`, else the `seams` pkg-config module (2.14 <= v < 3); the `bundled` feature compiles one from the seams-core tag in `seams-core.env` instead. The crate version is the seams-core release it binds. Contributor instructions are in the contributing guide at the repository root.

## Rust API

The reference is rustdoc, generated from the crates (`cargo doc --no-deps`).
`dseams` is the safe crate: every wrapper, with a doctest each. `System` is
one frame (`read`, `set_ortho`, `set_frame`, and every analysis). `Error`
is a library status with its message from `seams_handle_error`, an unnamed
status code, or a rejected argument. `ChillOptions` is the cutoff, species
filter, neighbour graph, and threshold table for CHILL and CHILL+.
`Rings` is primitive rings, with histograms, fractions, and vertex
iteration. `dseams-sys` is the raw declarations generated from `seams.h`.
The published pages are the docs.rs builds named by each crate's
`documentation` field.

## Repository docs

- [README](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs/blob/main/README.md): Install, how libseams is found, building against seams-core, the bundled build, publishing.
- [Book](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs/blob/main/docs/src/SUMMARY.md): Getting started, user guide, rustdoc API reference, and development.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs/blob/main/docs/src/getting-started.md): Install, link libseams, classify the eight-atom cell.
- [Ice Ih tutorial](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs/blob/main/docs/src/user-guide/ice-ih.md): The ice Ih census every d-SEAMS language front prints, in Rust.
- [dseams-sys README](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs/blob/main/dseams-sys/README.md): Link order, the `bundled` feature, `DEP_SEAMS_RPATH`, licenses of the bundled Eigen.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Released changes; unreleased fragments are in `changelog.d/`.

## Engine

- [d-SEAMS/seams-core](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/seams-core): The C++ engine, the libseams C API, the CLI and the C++ oracle these tests compare against.
- [seams.h](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/seams-core/blob/main/include/seams.h): The C API header `dseams-sys` is generated from.
- [docs.dseams.info](https://docs.dseams.info): d-SEAMS documentation: analyses, C API reference and every language front.

## Other language bindings

- [PydSEAMSlib](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/PydSEAMSlib): Python.
- [Dseams.jl](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/Dseams.jl): Julia.
- [dseams-r](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-r): R.
- [dseams-fortran](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-fortran): Fortran.
- [yodaStruct](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/yodaStruct): Lua.
